documentationDesc: Wige gukoresha Novera hanyuma ushishoze ibiranga.
releaseNotesDesc: Reba ibishya muri verisiyo iheruka ya Novera.

dataFolder.appDataDesc: Ikibanza cyubutumwa, imiterere yakuweho nandi makuru.

others.resetFactoryDesc: Kugarura porogaramu muburyo bwambere, guhanagura moderi zose namateka yo kuganira. Iki gikorwa ntigisubirwaho kandi kirasabwa gusa iyo porogaramu yangiritse.

interface.title: Imigaragarire
interface.notificationPositionDesc: Aho imenyekanisha rya toast rigaragara. Kuri Windows, isanzwe ni hepfo-iburyo kugirango popups idapfundikira igenzura rya Windows.
interface.showTokenSpeedDesc: Erekana ibimenyetso / amasegonda na token kubara umurongo munsi yubutumwa bwabafasha. Iyo uzimye, igishushanyo cyoroshye cyerekana ibisobanuro kuri kanda.
interface.coloredUserBubbleDesc: Koresha ibara ryerekana nkibisobanuro byubutumwa bwawe. Iyo bahagaritse, bahuza ubutumwa bwungirije hamwe ninyandiko isanzwe kumurongo utabogamye.
interface.renderHtmlArtifactsDesc: Ongeraho ibisobanuro mbere ya HTML na SVG kode ya kode. HTML ikoresha urupapuro rwakozwe na moderi mumasanduku yumusenyi ikora inyandiko zayo ariko ntishobora kugera Novera, dosiye zawe, cyangwa umuyoboro; SVG ihindura imibare hamwe ninyandiko zahagaritswe. Kureka kubisanzwe.
interface.autoGenerateTitleDesc: Mu buryo bwikora incamake y'ibiganiro bishya mumutwe wumutwe. Zimya kugirango ugumane umutwe usanzwe kugeza igihe uzahindura izina wenyine.
interface.windowBackgroundDesc: Shyira ibara rya idirishya rya porogaramu.
interface.appMainViewDesc: Shiraho ibice byingenzi bigize agace kinyuma yibara.
interface.accentDesc: Hitamo ibara ryerekana rikoreshwa muri UI.
interface.resetToDefaultDesc: Ongera usubize ibice byose byimiterere kugirango ube usanzwe.
interface.resetInterfaceSuccessDesc: Igenamiterere ryose ryimiterere ryasubijwe muburyo budasanzwe.
interface.threadScrollDesc: Hitamo uko ikiganiro cyo kureba kigomba kwitwara mugihe ubutumwa bushya bugeze.
interface.threadScrollFlowHint: Komeza kureba ibyerekeranye n'ubutumwa uheruka kohereza.
interface.threadScrollStickyHint: Mu buryo bwikora ikurikira nkuko ibisubizo bitemba mugihe nyacyo.
interface.tokenCounterCompactDesc: Erekana ikimenyetso cyimbere imbere yinjiza. Iyo byahagaritswe, ikimenyetso cyerekana munsi yinjiza.
interface.resetCodeBlockStyleDesc: Ongera usubize kode yo guhagarika uburyo busanzwe.
interface.resetCodeBlockSuccess: Kode yo guhagarika uburyo bwo gusubiramo neza
interface.resetCodeBlockSuccessDesc: Imiterere yo guhagarika kode yagaruwe muburyo budasanzwe.

hardware.name: Izina
hardware.enableVulkanDesc: Koresha Vulkan API kuri GPU yihuta. Ntugashoboze Vulkan niba ufite NVIDIA GPU kuko ishobora gutera ibibazo byo guhuza.
hardware.noDevicesDesc: Nta GPU igaragara kuri moteri llama.cpp. Moderi izakora kuri CPU.
hardware.backendSelectDesc: Koresha iyi API kuri iyi GPU
hardware.unifiedMemoryDesc: GPU isangiye pisine imwe yo kwibuka hamwe na CPU - moderi zishushanya mububiko bumwe nubundi sisitemu.
hardware.engineRestartedForDevices: GPU yawe yarahindutse, nuko moteri yaho yongeye gutangira. Abanyamideli bongeye kwifashisha ubutaha.
hardware.engineBusyDevicesChanged: GPU yawe yarahindutse, ariko moderi irahuze. Hagarika, hanyuma ukande Refresh kugirango ukoreshe GPU.

httpsProxy.proxyUrlDesc: URL hamwe nicyambu cya seriveri yawe.
httpsProxy.authenticationDesc: Ibyangombwa bya porokisi ya porokisi, niba bikenewe.
httpsProxy.noProxyDesc: Urutonde rwa koma rwatandukanijwe nabakiriye kugirango barengere proksi.
httpsProxy.ignoreSslDesc: Emerera umukono wenyine cyangwa ibyemezo bitemewe. Ibi birashobora gukenerwa kuri proksi zimwe ariko bigabanya umutekano. Gusa ushoboze niba wizeye proxy yawe.
httpsProxy.proxySslDesc: Emeza icyemezo cya SSL mugihe uhuza na proksi.

webSearch.title: Gushakisha Urubuga
webSearch.description: Reka abanyamideli bashakishe kandi basome urubuga ukoresheje ibikoresho byubatswe Novera.
webSearch.enableDesc: Kwamamaza ibikoresho web_search na web_fetch kubikoresho bigufasha gukoresha ibikoresho. Akora hanze yagasanduku nta API urufunguzo.
webSearch.providerDesc: Hitamo inyuma isubiza web_search na web_fetch.
webSearch.apiKeyOptional: Bihitamo. Tanga {{provider}} API urufunguzo rwibipimo biri hejuru nibisubizo byubatswe. Kureka ubusa kugirango ukoreshe amaherezo yubusa.
webSearch.apiKeyRequired: Birasabwa. {{provider}} ikeneye urufunguzo API kugirango usubize ibisubizo.
webSearch.endpointDesc: Birasabwa. Shingiro URL ya {{provider}} urugero, hamwe na JSON API ishoboye.

cowork.title: Cowork
cowork.description: Shyira hejuru ya agent ya Cowork: igikonoshwa cyayo cyumusenyi, wongeyeho kwibuka nubuhanga byakomeje burundu mububiko bwawe bwa Novera.
cowork.shellSandboxed: Amabwiriza akoreshwa afunzwe na {{backend}}: barashobora kwandika gusa imbere yumwanya wakazi, kandi dosiye mububiko bwawe ntibisomeka.
cowork.shellUnavailable: Nta sandbox iboneka kuri iyi sisitemu, igikoresho cya shell rero ntabwo gitangwa. Amabwiriza ntabwo yigeze akoreshwa adafite ibisobanuro.
cowork.networkDesc: Reka Cowork amategeko agere kumurongo, kubintu nko gushiraho paki cyangwa kuzana ububiko. Kuri Mburabuzi. Igikonoshwa nyamukuru igiceri ntigishobora kugera kumurongo.
cowork.noMemories: Nta kwibuka. Abanyamideli bongereho nibikoresho memory_write mugihe biga ibintu bikwiye kubika.
cowork.noSkills: Nta buhanga. Ubuhanga nuburyo bukoreshwa bwamabwiriza icyitegererezo gishobora kwikorera kubisabwa.
cowork.editMemoryDesc: Ingingo imwe kuri buri nyandiko. Abanyamideli basome ibi inyuma hamwe nibikoresho memory_read.
cowork.editSkillDesc: Amabwiriza ya Markdown, ubishaka hamwe nibisobanuro muri YAML imbere. Ibisobanuro nibyo moderi ibona mbere yo gupakira ubuhanga.

localApiServer.title: Seriveri API
localApiServer.serverLogsDesc: Reba amakuru arambuye ya seriveri yaho ya API.
localApiServer.swaggerDocsDesc: Reba ibyanditswe bya API bishobora kugerwaho (Swagger UI).
localApiServer.runOnStartupDesc: Tangira Seriveri y'aho ya API mu gihe porogaramu itangiye.
localApiServer.runInBackgroundDesc: Komeza seriveri ikora mu isanduku y'ibikorwa (system tray) igihe idirishya rifunze. Iyo iri off, gufunga idirishya bihagarika Novera kandi bihagarika seriveri.
localApiServer.serverHost: Izina rya seriveri cyangwa aderesi ya IP
localApiServer.serverPortDesc: Numero y'umuyoboro wa seriveri ya API.
localApiServer.apiPrefixDesc: Intambwe y'inzira ku mifatanyirize ya API.
localApiServer.apiKeyDesc: Hamagara ibisabwa ukoresheje urufunguzo rwa API.
localApiServer.trustedHostsDesc: Abashyitsi bemerewe kugera kuri server, batandukanyijwe n'uducurama.
localApiServer.corsDesc: Emera ibyifuzo biva ahandi ku server ya API.
localApiServer.verboseLogsDesc: Fungura logs za server zifite ibisobanuro birambuye kugirango ubashe gukora debugging.
localApiServer.proxyTimeoutDesc: Igihe cyo gutegereza igisubizo giturutse ku model y'ako gace, mu masegonda.
localApiServer.defaultModel: Server ya Model y’aho API ya default
localApiServer.defaultModelDesc: Model y’aho igomba kwikora mu buryo bwikora igihe server itangiye.

privacy.helpUsImproveDesc: Kugirango utubere inkunga mu kunoza Novera, ushobora gusangiza amakuru atazwi nka uko ikoreshwa ry’ibiranga n’imibare y’abakoresha. Ntitukivangura ibiganiro byawe cyangwa amakuru yawe bwite.
privacy.privacyPolicy: Ufite uburenganzira bwuzuye ku makuru yawe. Menya byinshi muri Politiki y’Ibijyanye n’Ubwihisho.
privacy.analyticsDesc: Kugira ngo twongere kunoza Novera, tugomba kumenya uko ikoreshwa—ariko ni wowe wenyine ushobora kudufasha. Ushobora guhindura iri fungurwa igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
privacy.privacyPromises: Amahitamo yawe hano ntazahindura ibyo twiyemeje ku bwirinzi bw'ibanga:
privacy.promise1: Ibiganiro byawe biguma ari ibanga kandi biri kuri mudasobwa yawe
privacy.promise2: Ntidukusanyiriza amakuru yawe bwite cyangwa ibyo uvuga mu biganiro
privacy.promise3: Gusangira amakuru byose bikorwa nta mazina kandi mu buryo buhurije hamwe
privacy.promise4: Ushobora guhagarika igihe icyo ari cyo cyose utabura imikorere

attachments.subtitle: Tegura inyandiko zifatika, imipaka y'ubunini, n'imikorere mu kuzisubiza.
attachments.enableDesc: Reba ko byemewe kohereza no gushiraho inyandiko kugira ngo ziboneke.
attachments.parseModeDesc: Hitamo uburyo inyandiko zasomwe zongerwa mu biganiro.
attachments.autoInlineThresholdDesc: Igice cy'ibikubiye muri model gikoreshwa nk'igipimo cyo kwandika inyandiko zasomwe ku makuru yaho.
attachments.maxFileDisabledReason: Tuma Enable Attachments kugira ngo uhindure umupaka w’ubunini bw’inyandiko.
attachments.maxFileDesc: Ubunini ntarengwa buri kuri buri nyandiko. Buri gihe bikorwa igihe cyo kohereza no gutunganya. Amafoto afite umupaka wayo hejuru hano.
attachments.maxImageDesc: Ubunini buhanitse kuri buri shusho (JPEG cyangwa PNG). Ikigo cyawe cyangwa icyitegererezo gishobora gushyiraho igipimo cyo hasi.
attachments.thresholdDesc: Icyapa cyo guhuzagurika (0-1). Bikora gusa ku gushakisha linear cosine, ntabwo kuri ANN.
attachments.searchModeDesc: Hitamo hagati ya sqlite-vec ANN, linear cosine, cyangwa auto.
attachments.chunkSizeDesc: Ubunini bwa hafi bw’inyuguti buri ku gice cyo gukora embeddings.

changeDataFolder.title: Hindura Data Ububiko
